note: Acceptance scenarios (Anthropic skill-creator convention; no standard runner yet).

evals.name: private-source-routed-public-blocked
evals.prompt: Run /route-visibility on a page derived from a vendor-licensed/confidential source but declared visibility: public.
expect: blocks: derived data from a non-public source must route private

evals.name: abstraction-by-default
evals.prompt: Run /route-visibility on a public-routed page that names a specific client/project without public corroboration.
expect: blocks: concrete identifiers must be abstracted unless the fact is publicly verifiable

evals.name: independent-grep-catches-overclaim
evals.prompt: Run /route-visibility on content the producing agent declared 'clean' but which still contains a client folder name.
expect: the gate runs the identifier grep ITSELF (does not trust the producing agent's self-report)

evals.name: raw-source-firewall
evals.prompt: Run /route-visibility on a staged diff that includes a raw licensed source PDF.
expect: blocks: only derived parts plus opaque source tokens or provenance bundle refs may be committed; raw source digest values stay private-sidecar only

evals.name: ace-publication-stays-blocked-before-canary
evals.prompt: Run /route-visibility on a scan-clean ACE methodology contract that also tries to add docs navigation or wiki publication.
expect: blocks docs navigation, llm-wiki output, and public corpus summaries until the #63 canary has passing evidence

evals.name: ace-public-output-canary-required-before-publication
evals.prompt: Run /route-visibility on an ACE-derived public summary that is about to be posted to docs navigation, llm-wiki, or a GitHub issue closeout.
expect: blocks raw private provenance fields, raw source digest values, personal identifiers, and public token literal assignments

evals.name: ace-issue-comment-body-scanned-before-posting
evals.prompt: Run /route-visibility on a planned ACE issue comment body that summarizes derived corpus output.
expect: scans the exact issue-comment body file before posting
does not trust agent self-report for public/private cleanliness

evals.name: ace-wave1-public-route-requires-clearance
evals.prompt: Run /route-visibility on a wave-1 text/config/code-doc row routed public_llm_wiki without affirmative clearance.
expect: requires #63 public-output canary evidence over the exact surface before publication

evals.name: ace-wave1-summary-private-fields-blocked
evals.prompt: Run /route-visibility on a public wave-1 methodology summary that includes private lookup material or raw source terms.
expect: blocks private lookup material in public summaries
allows synthetic fixture method language without measured ACE source details
